item.title: Super Real Mahjong P7
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mighty Craft, SETA Corporation
  • 発売日: 1998-05-21
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: スーパーリアル麻雀 P7
  • 英語名: Super Real Mahjong P7

别名

  • スーパーリアル麻雀 PVII

あらすじ

In hot summer, the protagonist comes to Izu for vacation, where he meets two Asahina sisters accompanied by their private tutor Serika and a part-time housekeeper Etsuko at the villa.

The girls challenge the protagonist in mahjong games for various reasons and a story of hot summer begins at the villa.

  • 英語名: Super Real Mahjong PVI

别名

  • スーパーリアル麻雀 P6

あらすじ

The protagonist incidentally helped an old man Kayama Toubei, who happened to be a mahjong master. Kayama insisted in giving the protagonist something in return as his gratitude, and the protagonist accidentally said “I want a bride!”, so the story begins where the protagonist must accept mahjong challenges from Kayama’s daughter and students as candidates for bride.
